summary: Retrieve a charitable organization by ID
description: This call is used to retrieve detailed information about supported charitable organizations. It allows users to retrieve the details for a specific charitable organization using its charity organization ID.

parameters.name: charity_org_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the charitable organization.

parameters.name: X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID
parameters.description: A header used to specify the eBay marketplace ID. Valid Values: EBAY_GB and EBAY_US
